news.title: Ford fends off Hyundai to retain No. 3 U.S. sales position in third quarter
news.description: Ford on Friday reported a year-over-year sales decline of 6.6% during the third quarter to 507,395 light-duty vehicles.

news.title: Men are losing ground in the labor market. Here's why
news.description: Women outnumbered men in the workforce for eight straight months as of September, according to one analysis.

news.title: FAA says Boeing 737 Max software glitch not a flight-safety issue
news.description: The FAA on Monday said it was reviewing the software glitch, which could affect procedures during certain landings.
